title: Ben Shelakot
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Niddah 52b: Rabbi Shimon said, “Chanina ben Chakhinai found me in Sidon and said: When you reach Rabbi Akiva, say to him: Did not Ben Shelakot testify in the presence of all of you at Yavneh…? When I came to Rabbi Akiva, he said to me: I do not know Ben Shelakot,” etc.
